fields.summary_ko.0: AVGO was downgraded by Rothschild analyst Mike Harrison with target price reduced from $595 to $398, showing less than 10% upside potential.
fields.summary_ko.1: Harrison is concerned about Broadcom's key customers Anthropic and OpenAI's funding dependence and intensifying competition, and Broadcom is currently providing loan guarantees of $11.3 billion to these companies.
